facts.fact: KfW's IATI record shows a EUR 15,000,000 grant (US$16.35 million), committed in 2025 for 2025-2028 with nothing yet disbursed, that finances extension of the fibre network and the connection of public institutions, named as town halls, hospitals and schools, to it.
